title: O Day of Rest and Gladness
description: O Day of Rest and Gladness in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 6 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Christopher Wordsworth, first published in 1862. The tune, WOODBIRD, is Traditional German. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: O day of rest and glad_-ness, o day of joy and light, O balm of care and sad_-ness, most beau-ti-ful, most bright: On thee, the high_ and low-ly, through a-ges joined in tune, Sing ho-ly, ho-ly, h_-oly, to the great God Tri-une.

lines: O day of rest and gladness,
o day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness,
On thee, the high and lowly,
the light first had its birth;
Christ rose from depths of earth;
And thus on thee, most glorious,
from storms that round us rise;
thou art a day of love,
D New graces ever gaining from this our day of rest,
We reach the rest remaining to spirits of the blessed.
To Holy Ghost be praises, to Father, and to Son;
The church her voice upraises to Thee, blessed Three in One.
